1. (Currently Amended) An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece so as to direct only visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe.

10. (Currently Amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a distal end of said handpiece and is oriented to provide illumination strictly along said probe to the surgical site.

12. (Currently Amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil capable of being positioned about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching said coil around the power cable.

19. (Currently Amended) A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directable along the longitudinal axis of said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said light source.

21. (Currently Amended) The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including positioning said coil around a power cable feeding said transducer or generator.
